text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been invited to a tea party at the
Mejiro
manor. When I arrive, though,
there seems to be
something amiss
about Mejiro Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I
must endure
this tea party...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Mejiro Lady
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't cute little Bright! Your
timing's
perfect! I was just about to go
into the kitchen
and whip up some good
old-fashioned brownies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Like the brownies you made back
then?!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Mejiro Lady
text_block_list.text:
The very same. Why, I remember when
you and
Ryan gobbled them down by
the plateful. How
many would you like?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As tempting an offer as that is, I feel
that perhaps
I should limit myself to tea
for today.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Mejiro Lady
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you do have your races to
consider,
don't you? Some other time,
then! Now, who
haven't I asked yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I thought it prudent to take a page
out of
McQueen's book.
choice_data_list: ……もしかして、お菓子我慢してる？
choice_data_list_en: ...Are you holding back on sweets, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family,
I can ill
afford not to look the part." I
saw her repeating
that to herself in the
mirror, without ever
breaking eye
contact.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And I hold McQueen in the highest
esteem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be wrong of me to
give in to
my sweet tooth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ♪ Your very presence is
empowering,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: それなら、お茶を楽しもう
choice_data_list_en: In that case, let's just enjoy our tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must strive to develop an unwavering

determination, just like McQueen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Mejiro Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, Little Miss McQueen. Two
brownies
just for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you, but... I really must
respectfully
decline...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Mejiro family enjoys their
tea party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, I beg your pardon, but as I just
said, I shall
be adopting McQueen's own
intentions as—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Point taken.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Mindless imitation is for the likes of
young
children.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I should be learning from her in other
ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me while I go to the kitchen. I'll
be sure to
bring some back for you as
well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Bright fully enjoys her
tasty trip
down memory lane!
